##### url()

```ts
url(url): void;
```

Show a URL inside the prompt frame as one unbroken line. `info()` and `step()`
add a status symbol; this keeps only the frame's "│" bar before the URL and
never inserts a line break, so the terminal soft-wraps it and a selection from
its first character copies the whole URL.

###### Parameters

| Parameter | Type     |
| --------- | -------- |
| `url`     | `string` |

###### Returns

`void`

##### link()

```ts
link(label, url): string;
```

An OSC 8 hyperlink around a short label, for terminals that render it. Falls
back to the plain label when output is non-interactive, piped, or NO_COLOR/dumb
— the same signal `info()` already uses to decide whether to use clack's styling
at all.

###### Parameters

| Parameter | Type     |
| --------- | -------- |
| `label`   | `string` |
| `url`     | `string` |

###### Returns

`string`
